properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated June 17, [1949], in Hong Kong; includes description of situation in China regarding the Nationalists and Communists and uncertainty of CNAC operation in Shanghai; mentions Sir Alexander and Lady Grantham, Bondy [William L. Bond], Alli [Ernest Allison], Mr. Gellion, Ki Chun, P.Y. Wong.
